description: This file defines a class `StatsCollectorGrain` implementing the `IStatsCollectorGrain` interface, used in Orleans framework for distributed actors, with methods to record and retrieve statistics call counts.

classes.name: StatsCollectorGrain
classes.description: A grain class in Orleans that collects statistics calls, with methods to record a call and get the total count.

methods.name: ReportStatsCalled
methods.description: Increments the count of statistics calls.

methods.name: GetReportStatsCallCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of times statistics have been reported.
